sentences.text: Blue Jasmine is a 2013 American black comedy-drama film written and directed by Woody Allen .	Woody Allen	Woody Allen	black	black comedy	comedy-drama film	comedy-drama film

The film tells the story of a rich Manhattan socialite -LRB- played by Cate Blanchett -RRB- who falls on hard times and has to move into her working class sister 's -LRB- Sally Hawkins -RRB- apartment in San Francisco .	Cate Blanchett	Cate Blanchett	Sally Hawkins	Sally Hawkins	San Francisco	San Francisco
The film had a limited release on July 26 , 2013 , in New York and Los Angeles , before expanding wide on August 23 , 2013 .
Blue Jasmine received praise from critics , particularly for Blanchett 's performance .

Blanchett won the Academy Award for Best Actress , and Hawkins and Allen were nominated for Best Supporting Actress and Original Screenplay , respectively .	Academy Award for Best Actress	Academy Award for Best Actress	Best Supporting Actress	Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress	Original Screenplay	Academy Award for Best Writing (Original Screenplay)

Blanchett also won the Golden Globe Award , the SAG Award , and the BAFTA Award for Best Actress in a Leading Role .	Golden Globe Award	Golden Globe Award for Best Actress in a Motion Picture – Drama	SAG Award	Screen Actors Guild Award for Outstanding Performance by a Female Actor in a Leading Role	BAFTA Award for Best Actress in a Leading Role	BAFTA Award for Best Actress in a Leading Role
The film was a box office success , earning $ 97.5 million worldwide against a budget of $ 18 million .
